title: IRSA role + aws-config ConfigMap for the AWS load balancer controller
description: Parent epic: infraplan-brt. aws-loadbalancer-config carries only the API LB DNS name. Add an IRSA role (modules/bootstrap/irsa-role) with the LB controller policy and a kube-system ConfigMap aws-load-balancer-controller-aws-config (AWS_ROLE_ARN, AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE, AWS_REGION) plus cluster name and VPC ID for the HelmRelease.

title: Publish karpenter-vars secret for Flux postBuild substitution
description: Parent epic: infraplan-brt. talos-aws-gitops drops the local karpenter-nodes Helm chart and renders EC2NodeClass/NodePool as plain manifests via postBuild.substituteFrom. Publish a flux-system Secret karpenter-vars with underscore keys (cluster_name, discovery_tag, node_ami_id, node_instance_profile, node_architecture) and JSON-encoded node_user_data (jsonencode, single-line YAML scalar) and capacity_types (jsonencode list, YAML flow sequence). Keep karpenter-config for the controller HelmRelease valuesFrom.

title: Point docs and examples at talos-aws-gitops; drop flux-kustomization.yaml
description:
README ('Flux bootstrap repository', usage example, clusters/template instructions) and examples/full reference pfenerty/flux-bootstrap. The Flux repo for these clusters is now pfenerty/talos-aws-gitops. Update the references and remove flux-kustomization.yaml once the gitops cluster template carries it.

Also: examples/full should set kubernetes_talos_api_access = { enabled = true }. The talos-aws-gitops template includes tuppr, whose chart creates a talos.dev ServiceAccount that only exists with that access on; without it the infra-controllers layer fails.
acceptance_criteria: No flux-bootstrap references remain; flux-kustomization.yaml removed; README links talos-aws-gitops.

title: Publish kubelet-csr-approver values so Flux can adopt the release
description: Parent epic: infraplan-brt. modules/bootstrap/csr-approver installs kube-system-kubelet-csr-approver with providerRegex (region-specific) and providerIpPrefixes (VPC CIDR). A Flux HelmRelease adopting it must carry the same values, and nothing publishes them. Publish a flux-system Secret (e.g. kubelet-csr-approver-config with values.yaml holding providerRegex, providerIpPrefixes, tolerations) for valuesFrom.

title: Drop hubble-trust-anchor once Cilium generates its own Hubble CA
description: Parent epic: infraplan-brt. talos-aws-gitops switches Cilium hubble.tls.auto.method to cronJob, so the Terraform-generated hubble-trust-anchor secret and hubble_ca_validity_hours become unused. Remove them after the gitops Cilium release is live on a cluster.
